boundaries.nodes: nodeSize then nodeColor on same IntermediateComputedNode without size/color/isActive, then full ComputedNode active/inactive size modifier, finally cacheparent. BFS source order. Rawnode.data exact original nested reference, not rawhierarchy aggregate.
boundaries.links: linkThickness then linkColor on same IntermediateComputedLink{id,source,target} with fully resolved computed endpoints, but no link thickness/color/isActive yet. Then optional active/inactive thickness modifier.
boundaries.fixDepth: finite threshold skips custom basecolor for deeper descendants and inherits already computed parentcolor; Infinity calls every source node. Color is not replayed just to obtain inherited parent color.
boundaries.labels: label receives full ComputedNode and runs before getPosition within original useLabels map, including size0/empty returnedtext. SVG hook invocation depends on labels layer+enableLabel; Canvas calls useLabels unconditionally regardless those draw gates.
boundaries.diameter: Original nodeSize is diameter, radius=size/2 in defaultNode. Rust old radius/inset/shape semantics and fifth radial orientation need explicit additivecontract preserving defaultpositions.
boundaries.deferred: Five basefunctions do not automatically implement active/inactive node/link sizefunctions, depthcolor fixing, arbitrarylabelComponent or functionlayers. These references record source differences, not pretend they are all shipped.
